questions.prompt: Not even the bravest soldier could endure so great a wound.
questions.answer: Nē fortissimus quidem mīles tantum vulnus tolerāre potuit.

questions.prompt: The old man praised his son, and even the daughter received gifts.
questions.answer: Senex fīlium laudāvit, et etiam fīlia dōna accēpit.

questions.prompt: The poet too recited his verses in the crowded forum.
questions.answer: Poēta quoque versūs suōs in forō frequentī recitāvit.

questions.prompt: I indeed feared nothing, though the enemy was pressing hard.
questions.answer: Ego quidem nihil timēbam, quamquam hostis vehementer urgēbat.

questions.prompt: I have no one here, neither friend nor kinsman.
questions.answer: Habeō hīc nēminem neque amīcum neque cognātum.

questions.prompt: Not even that danger must be passed over by a prudent leader.
questions.answer: Nē id quidem perīculum ā prūdentī duce praetereundum est.

questions.prompt: Not even he, worn out by poverty, abandoned his hope.
questions.answer: Nē ille quidem, egestāte cōnfectus, spem relīquit.

questions.prompt: Some indeed fled, but the rest fought bravely.
questions.answer: Nōnnūllī quidem fūgērunt, sed cēterī fortiter pugnāvērunt.

questions.prompt: The youth, by no means cowardly, hurled himself against the rampart.
questions.answer: Adulēscēns, haud ignāvus, sē in vāllum iniēcit.

questions.prompt: I scarcely know whether envy is lighter than poverty.
questions.answer: Haud sciō an invidia levior sit quam egestās.

questions.prompt: The task was by no means easy, yet he completed it.
questions.answer: Opus haud facile erat, tamen id perfēcit.

questions.prompt: Fearing nothing, the leader advanced by no means slowly.
questions.answer: Nihil timēns, dux haud lentē prōgrediēbātur.

questions.prompt: The soldiers were tired; they nevertheless stormed the walls.
questions.answer: Mīlitēs fessī erant; mūrōs tamen expugnāvērunt.

questions.prompt: This plan, however, seemed better to the older senators.
questions.answer: Hoc vērō cōnsilium senātōribus nātū maiōribus melius vīsum est.

questions.prompt: Though wounded, the brave man nevertheless did not yield.
questions.answer: Quamquam vulnerātus, vir fortis tamen nōn cessit.

questions.prompt: You indeed praise virtue, but you never practice it.
questions.answer: Tū vērō virtūtem laudās, sed eam numquam colis.

questions.prompt: Even the boldest, when they had seen the flames, feared death.
questions.answer: Etiam audācissimī, cum flammās vīdissent, mortem timuērunt.

questions.prompt: The mother too, moved by grief, wept for her lost son.
questions.answer: Māter quoque, dolōre commōta, fīlium āmissum flēvit.

questions.prompt: That speech indeed pleased the crowd more than the general had hoped.
questions.answer: Ea ōrātiō quidem multitūdinī magis placuit quam dux spērāverat.

questions.prompt: Not even in extreme peril did the consul lose his courage.
questions.answer: Nē in extrēmō quidem perīculō cōnsul animum āmīsit.

questions.prompt: The wretched man had nothing, neither bread nor shelter.
questions.answer: Miser homō nihil habēbat, neque pānem neque tēctum.

questions.prompt: No one ever gave anything to the greedy tyrant.
questions.answer: Nēmō umquam avārō tyrannō quicquam dedit.

questions.prompt: Never did the general, neither by threats nor by gifts, betray his allies.
questions.answer: Numquam dux, neque minīs neque dōnīs, sociōs prōdidit.

questions.prompt: Some, in fact, allotted their wealth to neither the poor nor the church.
questions.answer: Nōnnūllī quidem dīvitiās suās neque pauperibus neque ecclesiae tribuērunt.
